content.7.1: Patients with an implantable cardioverter defibrillator are reviewed with studies such as CALYPSO and MADIT-II. Ejection fraction and primary prevention indications are specifically noted.
content.7.2: Nonischemic cardiomyopathy studies highlight outcomes in patients with conditions like sarcoidosis, and the impact of late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac events is studied.
content.7.2.1: Secondary prevention of SCD in patients with NICM is discussed with results from the AVID study and its implications.
content.7.2.1.1: The Antiarrythmics versus Implantable Defibrillators (AVID) study reviews arrhythmic therapy outcomes.
content.7.2.1.2: Review of a trial comparing amiodarone versus ICD in post-MI and low ejection fraction patients.
content.7.2.4: Review of trials indicated secondary prevention of cardiac arrest comparing ICDs and antiarrhythmic drugs.
content.7.2.7: Genetic basis highlighted in studies related to dilated cardiomyopathy and other conditions.

genes.context: 7.2.7 includes studies focusing on lamin A/C mutation carriers with data on conduction disorders and cardiomyopathy outcomes. The cardiac profiles of carriers of LMNA mutations and their significance in arrhythmias are noted.
Mentioned in the context of genetic mutations that affect heart rhythm conditions, particularly related to arrhythmias.
